content: OpenVLA-OFT requires a CUSTOM transformers fork: git+https://github.com/moojink/transformers-openvla-oft.git (bidirectional attention for parallel decoding). Confirmed from pyproject.toml. Model IDs: moojink/openvla-7b-oft-finetuned-libero-spatial, moojink/openvla-7b-oft-finetuned-libero-10, moojink/openvla-7b-oft-finetuned-libero-object, moojink/openvla-7b-oft-finetuned-libero-goal. Validated on Python 3.10.14, PyTorch 2.2.0, custom transformers fork (based on 4.40.1), on A100. Loading uses custom get_vla() utility, not AutoModelForVision2Seq directly. For Phase 1 ENV-03 (load check), can use AutoModelForVision2Seq.from_pretrained('moojink/openvla-7b-oft-finetuned-libero-spatial', trust_remote_code=True, torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16) — action is 7-D. openvla-oft pyproject.toml pins: torch==2.2.0, timm==0.9.10, tokenizers==0.19.1, peft==0.11.1, sentencepiece==0.1.99, flash-attn==2.5.5. LIBERO eval also needs: imageio[ffmpeg], robosuite==1.4.1, bddl, easydict, cloudpickle, gym.
